notes: Wayland primary selection first, X11 fallback, UTF-8-safe max_bytes enforcement, compositor/tool detection, timeout, invalid UTF-8, stale clipboard.

capture_methods.priority: primary first, then clipboard after force-copy attempt

cases.description: Primary selection returns valid UTF-8 text within max_bytes
Large selection truncated on UTF-8 char boundary, truncated flag true, notification shown

expected.notification: Selection truncated: captured first 204800 bytes of larger selection.

cases.notes: Truncation must not split multi-byte UTF-8 sequences; uses char boundary

cases.description: Truncation with multi-byte characters (emoji, CJK) preserves valid UTF-8

expected.text: must be valid UTF-8 and truncated at char boundary, not mid-codepoint

cases.description: Tool output with invalid UTF-8 bytes replaced or rejected gracefully

expected.notes: Invalid bytes replaced with U+FFFD or sanitized; no panic

cases.description: Empty primary triggers force-copy attempt then clipboard fallback
No selection found after all fallbacks returns exit 2 with notification

expected.stderr_contains: No selection found. Select text and press Meta+R again.

cases.description: No DISPLAY/WAYLAND_DISPLAY yields exit 5 and notification
wl-paste and xclip both missing yields exit 5
cases.error: ToolMissing: wl-paste and xclip not found

cases.description: Wayland session prefers wl-paste; X11 not tried if Wayland succeeds
Clipboard content older than selection timestamp is considered stale (optional)
cases.expected: may be treated as stale if newer primary exists; behavior documented as best-effort

cases.description: Subprocess timeout 2.0s default; busy compositor yields timeout error

expected.error: Timeout: wl-paste did not return within 2.0s

cases.description: speak-clipboard on empty clipboard reminds to press Ctrl+C

expected.stderr_contains: clipboard is empty. Press Ctrl+C first

invariants: Capture never panics on invalid UTF-8
Truncation is always on UTF-8 char boundary
Empty primary before fallback is not an error (exit 2 only after all fallbacks fail)
ToolMissing and DisplayUnavailable are exit 5, not 1 or 2
